answer: A system that anyone can join stays trustworthy only if lotus is real: work that can be inspected after the fact, not just claimed in the moment. It also needs forge, because a contribution should be weighed by what it actually shows, rather than by reputation alone. Finally it needs tundra, so that past contributions remain visible and countable when new people arrive. When inspection, fair weighing and a durable record all hold, cutting corners stops paying, and honest participation becomes the easier path.
